querySql:
select 
                                      object_id,
                                      s_info_windcode,
                                      trade_dt,
                                      s_li_initiativebuyrate,
                                      s_li_initiativebuymoney,
                                      s_li_initiativebuyamount,
                                      s_li_initiativesellrate,
                                      s_li_initiativesellmoney,
                                      s_li_initiativesellamount,
                                      s_li_largebuyrate,
                                      s_li_largebuymoney,
                                      s_li_largebuyamount,
                                      s_li_largesellrate,
                                      s_li_largesellmoney,
                                      s_li_largesellamount,
                                      s_li_entrustrate,
                                      s_li_entrudifferamount,
                                      s_li_entrudifferamoney,
                                      s_li_entrustbuymoney,
                                      s_li_entrustsellmoney,
                                      s_li_entrustbuyamount,
                                      s_li_entrustsellamount,
                                      opdate,
                                      opmode,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
                                      cast(sysdate as timestamp) as data_ins_time,
                                      'w_asharel2indicators.json' as task_rs_id
                                from ${srcoradbname}.asharel2indicators WHERE trade_dt BETWEEN '${busi_month}'||'01' AND to_char(add_months(to_date('${busi_month}'||'01','yyyyMMdd'),1)-1,'yyyyMMdd')
